qdevice_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the qdevice server.

qdevice_port.description: TCP port on which the qdevice daemon listens (default: 5403).

tls_ca_file.description: Path to the TLS CA certificate used to verify the qnetd server.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the qdevice's TLS certificate (for mutual authentication).

tls_key_file.description: Path to the qdevice's TLS private key.

algorithm.description: Quorum algorithm: 'ffsplit' (fault-tolerant, requires > 50% nodes + qdevice) or 'lms' (simple, requires qdevice to break tie).

tie_breaker_node_id.description: Node ID used to break ties in quorum calculations (typically highest node ID in cluster).

heuristics_mode.description: Heuristic execution mode: 'sync' (wait for results) or 'async' (non-blocking).

heuristics.description: List of heuristics to run; each script's exit status contributes to quorum (non-zero = vote down).

name.description: Identifier for the heuristic (must be unique).

interval.description: Interval in milliseconds between heuristic runs.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds after which the heuristic is considered failed.

program.description: Path to the executable script or binary.

args.description: Optional list of arguments passed to the heuristic program.

score.description: Vote weight when heuristic passes (positive = vote up, negative = vote down). Defaults to ±1 depending on algorithm.

qnetd_host.description: Host of the qnetd server (if remote). Usually same as qdevice_host unless using a dedicated qnetd.

qnetd_port.description: Port of the qnetd server (if remote). Usually same as qdevice_port unless configured otherwise.

connect_timeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for connection to qnetd before failing.

reconnect_interval.description: Seconds between reconnection attempts to qnetd after failure.

quorum_votes.description: Number of votes the qdevice contributes when quorum is active.

heuristics_votes.description: If true, heuristic results may override static quorum votes (algorithm-dependent).
